notes.title: UPDATE 30/01/2019
notes.content:
Hey! Here we go again.
[b]So I'm constantly making improvements in the game as you can tell.
This time we take some pictures, we put others and we will continue until reaching a satisfactory goal.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34218378/b4b19f4e5f1bb3e6b798c30e0081b18150ddbe8d.png[/img]

[b]The changes in this update are:[/b]
[i]- Graphic Improvements (Menu and backgrounds).
- More colors.
- New Images.
- Auto-mode is now Hand Free (After activating it will skip phase without you 
  having to use your hands for it;) just wait a little bit)
- How the game loads optimized.[/i]

[b]Knowed Issues:[/b]
[i]Auto-save is sucks, we will provide a better way to save and load the game.[/i]

[b]What's next:[/b]
[i]- The gallery will open as you get coins, releasing new images as you 
   progress.
- More images (We are in contact with artists to provide even more images 
  for you.)
- Better use of currencies.
- More songs.
- MORE ACHIEVED.
- Fixes more bugs.
- As soon as possible: Cards, Backgrounds and similar. (It depends more on you than on me :))[/i]


[b]If you have any ideas that you would like to share, please, before doing a negative review, talk to me, I will provide as soon as possible the changes. Do not be an asshole, help rather than harm, the advantage is all yours.[/b]

[u]Love yourself.[/u]

Well, as many already know, we suffered with a former artist who sent us images that violated copyright.ːsteamfacepalmː

Due to this and to be able to continue our project we had to remove such images.

We currently replace some and there are new temporary images in the game.
We are working 24/7 to correct this error and deliver the product we promised, so we ask for a little patience while our orders are not shipped.

To compensate for the lack of many images we added[b] 30 new achievements.[/b] And we will try to feed the game with new images as new artists send us.

To compensate also, we will make [b]our next 2 dlcs available for free.[/b]

Stay tuned for news.
Thank you for understanding and sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Launch things and more!
notes.content:
[b]We are so proud of our launch.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34218378/b412fd6dd558308b0c46a34566bbb1cde4640f1f.png[/img]
And we've already fixed some bugs, here's the list:

[u][b]- Achievements won.
- More than 100 images released.
- Gallery Released.
- Compatibility with Win 32 / 64bits.[/b][/u]

[b]Please help us make a better game.[/b]
[i]Every 10 positive reviews we will giveaway 1 Key here for one of our games.[Just review and You will already be participating.][/i]
We need reviews and downloads to release the cards and more achivements and of course to continue making games.

We have plans for our upcoming games to be even more interesting and satisfying to you.

[b] We count on your participation.[/b]
